Samir / Laura — attaching our canary evaluation plan PDF (auroraedge_canary_eval_plan.pdf) and a short checklist. Quick summary of the KPIs I put in the plan:

- Latency: p95 < 320ms (end-to-end) for canary flows; immediate rollback if p95 > 420ms or 5% increase vs baseline
- Error/exception rate: < 0.5% on canary requests; alert at 1%
- Semantic regression (quality): allowed false-positive rate <= 1.8% measured on the eval set; if above threshold, hold expansion and run prompt/model tweak cycle
- Model drift / token-usage variance: monitor token distribution; if 20% increase in median tokens consumed, flag for cost review

Link to the live eval results dashboard: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AuriaMAPDraft (view-only). I added the 25% expansion date to Sep 12 per Samir's change freeze note.

Notes: we'll run daily golden-set checks during canary weeks and add an automated regen step if a regression is detected.

Jonas
